title: Chapter 368 Dark Forbidden Zone
content:
Chapter 368 Dark Forbidden Zone

Hearing this question, Old Liang was slightly stunned, his loving smile slowly dissipated, and turned into a solemn look on his face.

Seeing the change in Mr. Liang's face, Lu Xue's heart moved slightly.

It seems that this old senior knows something.

Sure enough, Old Liang's lips moved slightly and he sighed slowly.

"The Palace Master is worthy of being the successor of the Human Emperor. As expected, he has discovered that these three tribes are not simple."

Lu Xue stared at Old Liang in front of her, her eyelashes moved slightly, but she didn't say anything.

She did find some problems, but she didn't know the specific one.

Seeing that Lu Xue didn't say anything, Mr. Liang was silent for a moment and suddenly asked, "District Master, have you not noticed that these three tribes have anything in common?"

The same place?

Lu Xue pondered slightly and said in confusion: "These three tribes are all powerful tribes in the Chaos Realm."

Mr. Liang shook his head.

Lu Xue said again: "These three tribes have all strong men who have broken out of the Chaos Realm."

Mr. Liang still shook his head.

"What is that?"

Lu Xue frowned very tightly, and she became more and more confused.

Old Liang chuckled and slowly looked at Lu Xue, "District Master, haven't you noticed that the names of these three tribes all contain the word "Divine"?"

god!

Lu Xue was shocked and blurted out: "What do you mean is these three tribes related to God?"

God, she is naturally familiar with it.

In the past, there was a state of divine success.

But at this moment she knew that the God that Mr. Liang mentioned was definitely not the same as the God she knew.

Sure enough, Old Liang nodded and his expression became solemn.

Although he is not the strongest existence in the human race, for some reason, he lived for a long time and did not die due to accidents.

Therefore, he knew a lot about the human race and even the entire Chaos Realm.

The same is true for these three tribes.

"These three tribes are most likely descendants of God in the legend."

Descendants of God.

Hearing Mr. Liang's words, Lu Xue slowly stood up.

"So, the reason why these three tribes are so fearless is because they have a backer behind them."

"So that's it."

Lu Xue's face gradually calmed down.

Compared to her backer, Lu Xue has never been afraid of anyone.

Although she didn't know where her father was now, she believed that if the so-called god behind the other party dared to show up, her father would never sit idly by.

After thinking it through, Lu Xue no longer had any worries.

"Old Liang, thank you."

"It is my honor to be able to solve the doubts of the Palace Master."

Old Liang stood up, bowed slightly to Lu Xue, and then slowly left.

Looking at the old back of Mr. Liang and his staggering steps, Lu Xue's heart moved slightly.

She thought of the fruit of immortality in their deserted city.

Although Mr. Liang has lived for a long time, if there is a fruit of immortality, Mr. Liang will definitely be able to live longer. Maybe he can go to a higher level and live a second life.

The deserted city.

Yes, there is a deserted city behind her.

Why didn’t my dad bring Huangcheng here?

At the same time, in a hidden space above the void, Lu Daosheng was standing here, watching all this lightly.

He smiled with a smile on his lips, with a look of praise in his eyes.

"It seems that Xiaoxue can do a good job without me."

He originally wanted to take action directly and suppress the three tribes.

But now, he took back the decision.

The human race will solve these three tribes themselves. If you have your own daughter, there will be no problem.

He believes in his daughter.

Immediately, Lu Daosheng withdrew his gaze and turned around and left the Chaos Realm.

Faced with the obstacles from outside the boundary, Lu Daosheng was as if he had entered a state of no one, coming and going freely.

The space moved slightly, and Lu Daosheng's figure had already appeared outside the Chaos Realm.

Looking at the endless darkness in front of him and the void turbulence everywhere, the creatures would be torn apart at any time, Lu Daosheng's eyes moved slightly, and gradually emitted a faint light.

In an instant, two beams of light shot out and shot towards the end of the darkness.

After a long time, an angry shout came.

"Rareless! Who dares to spy on me!"

The sound exploded like thunder and came into Lu Daosheng's ears.

Lu Daosheng ignored his remarks and his expression remained unchanged, but he just took his eyes lightly back.

"Ah, is the world really endless?"

This chaotic world is like a star in the sky and a grain of sand and dust in the desert, so small.

However, this area has countless worlds such as Chaos Realm.

There are countless broken worlds.

They float aimlessly, and from time to time they experience violent vibrations, explosions, or destruction.

In time, the Chaos Realm will eventually come into the footsteps.

If this is the case, then what is the point of all this?

Lu Daosheng began to ponder.

But at this moment, the sound of space turbulence suddenly came from a distance.

Rumble!

The space continues to collapse, and the void flows scattered.

A dark door that seemed to come from hell slowly opened.

laugh!

A ferocious black giant claw suddenly stretched out from the inside of the door and grabbed it outside the door.

In a blink of an eye, a strange and decaying aura surged out.

Seeing this scene, Lu Daosheng frowned slightly because this aura had begun to affect the Chaos Realm at this moment.

The extremely strong barrier to void that once blocked countless strong people began to melt.

If this aura poured into the Chaos Realm, it was hard to imagine what would have been a tragic result.

Lu Daosheng no longer hesitated and raised his empty hand slightly.

Suddenly, a sword light flashed.

laugh!

The giant black hand cut off at the same root, and deep black blood kept gushing out.

Immediately afterwards, a hideous scream came from the gate of darkness.

Jie—

"Noisy."

Lu Daosheng waved his hand again, and the door of darkness was shattered.

The sound dissipated and the void fell into solemnity again.

However, the dark black blood was spreading here, as if telling that a terrifying monster had just appeared here.

Looking at the disgusting blood in front of him, Lu Daosheng was silent for a moment and turned to look at the Chaos Realm.

Lu Daosheng spread his right hand and a dazzling white light gradually emerged.

The white light was as dazzling as the scorching sun.

It squirmed slowly, as if there was life.

"Go."

Lu Daosheng's lips moved slightly.

The next moment, the white light slowly flew towards the outer barrier in front of him.

Ripples came from the space.

This white light was like a fish entering the sea, and soon disappeared without a trace.

However, the outer barriers at this time have undergone earth-shaking changes.

Unless the opponent's strength is higher than Lu Daosheng, no creature can forcibly break into the Chaos Realm.

After doing all this, Lu Daosheng nodded slightly, then his body trembled and disappeared from the spot.

But Lu Daosheng did not notice that before he made this move, an extremely subtle, invisible deep black blood bead had floated into the Chaos Realm.

Chaos Realm.

All living creatures looked up at the sky at the same time.

They only felt a disgusting breath coming, and the next moment, the void seemed to be changing.

But when they looked at it intently, they could not see anything.

At the same time, a drop of blood fell here in the edge of the Chaos Realm, and the entire area instantly turned into a hell-like forbidden zone.

All living beings either die or darken.

Deep in the penalty area, a black monster appeared out of thin air and opened his dark green eyes.
